preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TRIGGER_NAME = 'trg_transaction_record_after_insert'

changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_transaction_record_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON transaction_record FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF YEAR(NEW.transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(NEW.transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN UPDATE ledger SET current_month_balance = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM transaction_record WHERE ledger_id = NEW.ledger_id AND transaction_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND transaction_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) WHERE id = NEW.ledger_id; END IF; END

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TRIGGER_NAME = 'trg_transaction_record_after_update'

changeSet.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_transaction_record_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON transaction_record FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF YEAR(OLD.transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(OLD.transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN UPDATE ledger SET current_month_balance = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM transaction_record WHERE ledger_id = OLD.ledger_id AND transaction_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND transaction_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) WHERE id = OLD.ledger_id; END IF;
IF NEW.ledger_id <> OLD.ledger_id AND YEAR(NEW.transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(NEW.transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN UPDATE ledger SET current_month_balance = ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM transaction_record WHERE ledger_id = NEW.ledger_id AND transaction_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND transaction_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ) WHERE id = NEW.ledger_id; END IF; END
